content:
Rumors about the new Apple TV 4K have been circulating, with reports suggesting it will feature a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence. But a new leak discovered by Aaron Perris indicates that its chip performance will be even more powerful than expected.

Leaked code shows the upcoming Apple TV 4K will be equipped with the A19 or A19 Pro chip

We've been waiting for the new Apple TV 4K for quite some time — longer than any period in the product's history.

There were originally rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence pointing to the use of the A17 Pro chip. That chip is currently the minimum requirement to support Apple Intelligence, so it made perfect sense and would have been a clear upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

But according to Aaron Perris, the new Apple TV 4K will feature an even better chip than expected. He wrote:

We've found information about Apple's upcoming Apple TV model, AppleTV18,1

razmsu pinned comment

All I want is for the remote to make a sound so I can find it when I lose it. That's it. Please.

The '18,1' identifier is similar to last year's iPhone 17 lineup. Some iPhone 17 models use the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Both chips would bring a considerable upgrade to the Apple TV. But I think the A19 Pro is more likely, since it's the only one that supports the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the new Apple TV 4K. Given how long it's been since the last hardware update, I hope Apple doesn't miss out on some of those AI features right after launching the new model.

Are you planning to buy the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
